system.history:
A neutral-purpose hostile operative ready to be reskinned as a gang member, cult guard, criminal hireling, corporate enforcer, or uniformed invader.

Scene use: Duplicate as needed, rename the group, and adjust disposition or equipment to fit the encounter.
system.personality: Follows simple orders, works with nearby allies, and values survival once the plan collapses.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Assign a shared color, insignia, uniform, or piece of equipment to identify the faction.

system.description: A basic close attack suitable for whichever equipment the minion carries.
